name: mcp-headless-app
title: Headless MCP App
description: A complete headless MCP app: static OAuth screens, an MCP Edge Function, and PostgREST database tools.

files.content:
# Headless MCP App configuration.
#
# This is a complete starter config for a new local Supabase project. Update
# project_id and the two browser origins before deploying the static app.

# Use a distinct value when multiple local Supabase projects run on this machine.
project_id = "headless-mcp-app"

[api]
enabled = true
# `public` is where PostgREST discovers tables and functions for the MCP tools.
schemas = ["public", "graphql_public"]
extra_search_path = ["public", "extensions"]
# New public entities are not auto-exposed. Grant the authenticated role the
# required operations and enable RLS for every table used by MCP tools.
# auto_expose_new_tables = true

[auth]
enabled = true
# Replace both URLs with the origin where you host this block's static files.
site_url = "http://localhost:3000"
additional_redirect_urls = ["http://localhost:3000/auth/"]

[auth.oauth_server]
enabled = true
authorization_url_path = "/oauth/consent/"
allow_dynamic_registration = true

[auth.hook.custom_access_token]
enabled = true
uri = "pg-functions://postgres/private/mcp_custom_access_token_hook"

[functions.mcp-server]
# The function verifies OAuth and Supabase bearer tokens itself.
verify_jwt = false

docs: Required setup: this starter block installs `supabase/config.toml` with OAuth, access-token-hook, and Edge Function settings. Fill in its `project_id`, `site_url`, and `additional_redirect_urls` for your static app host, then set `SUPABASE_URL` and `SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` in `config.js`. The `--yes --overwrite` install command intentionally replaces both this starter config and `supabase/functions/mcp-server/tools/index.ts`; merge those files manually if your project already has either one. Deploy with `supabase db push`, `supabase config push`, and `supabase functions deploy mcp-server`. The complete manifest already registers the PostgREST toolset; no manual source edit is needed. See the block documentation for the local quickstart and RLS/grant requirements.
